raw_comment:
- I noticed that the places with the most drought are in the middle of the US while the far ends of the US are abnormally dry or moderate.
-I wonder the main cause for certain areas to be extreme drought and those nearby to be abnormally dry.
-This relates to me and my community because whether there is a lot of drought or it is dry it affects the people living in that area and may lead to problems within my community.
-Dry or drought doubt in the US
